subject: planner: introduce PlanContext to provide context for planner phase (#51074)
summary: Introduces `pkg/planner/context.PlanContext` (plus extracted `ValueStoreContext`) and refactors planner/executor/stats/table code to use it, including updating planner plan SCtx type and decoupling several infoschema/ranger helpers from `sessionctx.Context`; changes appear mechanical with no remaining Blocker/High correctness, semantics, privilege, concurrency, or transaction/session issues found in this commit.
